title: Code that types itself
subtitle: A snippet written line by line with its output beside it, then a change typed into a diff

scenes.narration: Here is FizzBuzz, written from scratch.

steps.say: Make a function that counts from one to n.
A number that divides by fifteen prints FizzBuzz.
Otherwise three prints Fizz, five prints Buzz, and anything else prints the number.
Call it with fifteen, run it, and it prints every line up to FizzBuzz.
steps.output:
$ node fizzbuzz.js
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
[FizzBuzz]{good}

scenes.narration: The fetch now tries again when the server fails.

steps.say: Try up to three times, and return any answer that is not a server error.
steps.output:
$ npm test
[✗ retries a 503]{bad} expected 1 call to be 3

steps.say: After three failures, throw an error that names the address.
